compose.label: To verify something suspicious I received
To ask a question unrelated to a suspicious email
To follow up on a previous email

archive.label: I wanted it out of my inbox but didn't want to delete it
It seemed legitimate but I didn't need to act on it now
I might need to reference it later

delete.label: The sender looked unfamiliar or suspicious
It seemed like spam or irrelevant
I didn't want to risk interacting with it
It used urgent or pressuring language
Something about the wording/formatting felt off

report_phishing.label: I was confident it was a phishing attempt
It asked for personal or account information
It used urgent or pressuring language
I wanted to alert IT/security to protect others
The sender or link address looked spoofed

reply.label: I recognized and trusted the sender
The request seemed reasonable and routine
I needed to respond to their question/request
It seemed urgent and I wanted to address it quickly

forward.label: I wanted a colleague or IT to review it
It seemed relevant to someone else
I wanted a second opinion before acting
It seemed legitimate and worth sharing

click_link.label: I recognized and trusted the sender
I wanted to see where the link led
The link seemed relevant to my work/life
I needed to access whatever it linked to

open_attachment.label: I recognized and trusted the sender
I needed the information in the file
I wanted to see what it contained

ignore.label: I wasn't sure what to do about it
I wanted to deal with it later
It seemed legitimate but didn't require a response

verify_independently.label: I wasn't sure if it was legitimate
I wanted to confirm before taking any action
Something about it seemed suspicious but not definitively
It's my habit to check before responding to this kind of request
